# linux-kernel — 2012 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 80 linux-kernel CVEs of 2012 are in `data/cve/vendors/linux-kernel/2012.jsonl`.

### CVE-2012-0045
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2012-07-03 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 36545: Linux Kernel 3.1.8 - KVM Local Denial of Service (dos/linux, 2011-12-29, verified=1)

The em_syscall function in arch/x86/kvm/emulate.c in the KVM implementation in the Linux kernel before 3.2.14 does not properly handle the 0f05 (aka syscall) opcode, which allows guest OS users to cause a denial of service (guest OS crash) via a crafted application, as demonstrated by an NASM file.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2012-0055
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2020-02-19 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: UNKNOWN_TYPE
- Exploit-DB 36571: OverlayFS inode Security Checks - 'inode.c' Local Security Bypass (local/linux, 2012-01-17, verified=1)

OverlayFS in the Linux kernel before 3.0.0-16.28, as used in Ubuntu 10.0.4 LTS and 11.10, is missing inode security checks which could allow attackers to bypass security restrictions and perform unauthorized actions.

Affected:
- Linux kernel / OverlayFS: affected before 3.0.0-16.28; affected as used in Ubuntu 10.0.4 LTS and 11.10

### CVE-2012-0056
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2012-01-27 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 18411: Linux Kernel 2.6.39 < 3.2.2 (Gentoo / Ubuntu x86/x64) - 'Mempodipper' Local Privilege Escalation (1) (local/linux, 2012-01-23, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 35161: Linux Kernel 2.6.39 < 3.2.2 (x86/x64) - 'Mempodipper' Local Privilege Escalation (2) (local/linux, 2012-01-12, verified=1)

The mem_write function in the Linux kernel before 3.2.2, when ASLR is disabled, does not properly check permissions when writing to /proc/<pid>/mem, which allows local users to gain privileges by modifying process memory, as demonstrated by Mempodipper.

### CVE-2012-3375
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2012-10-03 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 19605: Linux Kernel 3.2.24 - 'fs/eventpoll.c' Local Denial of Service (dos/linux, 2012-07-05, verified=1)

The epoll_ctl system call in fs/eventpoll.c in the Linux kernel before 3.2.24 does not properly handle ELOOP errors in EPOLL_CTL_ADD operations, which allows local users to cause a denial of service (file-descriptor consumption and system crash) via a crafted application that attempts to create a circular epoll dependency.  NOTE: this vulnerability exists because of an incorrect fix for CVE-2011-1083.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2012-3430
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2012-10-03 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 37543: Linux Kernel 2.6.x - 'rds_recvmsg()' Local Information Disclosure (local/linux, 2012-07-26, verified=1)

The rds_recvmsg function in net/rds/recv.c in the Linux kernel before 3.0.44 does not initialize a certain structure member, which allows local users to obtain potentially sensitive information from kernel stack memory via a (1) recvfrom or (2) recvmsg system call on an RDS socket.

- Exploit-DB 41767: Linux Kernel (Ubuntu 11.10/12.04) - binfmt_script Stack Data Disclosure (dos/linux, 2014-01-14, verified=0)

### CVE-2012-5375
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2013-02-18 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 38132: Linux Kernel 3.3.5 - Btrfs CRC32C feature Infinite Loop Local Denial of Service (dos/linux, 2012-12-13, verified=1)

The CRC32C feature in the Btrfs implementation in the Linux kernel before 3.8-rc1 allows local users to cause a denial of service (prevention of file creation) by leveraging the ability to write to a directory important to the victim, and creating a file with a crafted name that is associated with a specific CRC32C hash value.
